title: fix(runtime): the MCP doc tools name a page's manual in the request's locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HaZKB3oyHkN7hYoUHf2Qma)_

Fixes #36854

## 维护者速读

- 问题：外接 AI 读应用手册时，页面标题按语言翻译了，手册名却还是英文。
- 改了什么：两个文档工具返回的手册名，改用 `/meta/book` 同一套翻译（`books.<手册>.label`），语言与页面一致；没有译文时保留原名。
- 不变的：手册归属、地址、可见性规则都不动。
- 要你做什么：暂无，等 L1 复核。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-docs.ts`: `PackageDocsSources` gains an optional `translateBooks(books, locale)`. A new `bookLabelsIn` asks it once per call and `addressOf` serves `book.label` from it by manual name, falling back to the authored label. `search_package_docs` uses the request's locale; `read_package_doc` uses the locale the page is served in (`input.locale ?? request locale`), so the manual name and the page title speak one language.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`: the docs seam wires `translateBooks` to `translateMetaList(..., 'book', ...)`, the routine `GET /meta/book` runs (`translateBook` in the spec's translator table), with this request's i18n service and protocol (`metaTranslationSources`) and the page's locale. ⛔ No second translation routine.
- The home manual is still picked from the manuals as listed: only the label is read from the translation, so a translation never moves a page to another manual or changes its URL.

## Why

A HotCRM user in zh-CN asking 「什么是回款？」 got the page title in Chinese and the manual cited as "HotCRM Order to Cash Manual", although HotCRM ships `books.crm_o2c_manual.label` = 「HotCRM 订单与回款手册」. Found in the #35442 acceptance run (comment 7122547546 on #36843).

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp-package-docs.test.ts`: 21/21 pass. The new `[#36854]` block pins: zh-CN search and read both serve `book.label` = 销售手册; a manual the bundle does not name keeps its authored label and its address; no locale, or a read asking for `en`, serves the authored label.
- Red before the fix: with the two source files reverted, the zh-CN case fails (1 failed, 20 passed).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp`: 10 files, 343 tests pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: OK.
- The derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) run in CI on this PR.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Acceptance notes

- Edge left as is: when two manuals of a package share `order`, the Console sorts the translated list by label while this door picks the home manual from the untranslated list. Only a tie on `order` can make them differ; not filed (no reproduction in a shipped app).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
